mutations.because: The whole lane is that the event's own pr number is the join key. Invert the preference and the lane whose branch slug was reworded (L2a-compositor-layer-list shipped as feat/l2a-layer-list) loses its PR in the recorded fixture again — the exact data C1 was measured on, which no branch rule could ever have joined.

Case was one half of the measured zero intersection (lanes are written L3b, branches lowercased). Drop the case fold and the recorded fixture collapses back toward zero: M2, W2b1-log-toolbar, H1a-tokens-selector and every other case-only join disappears.

The descendant rule must stop at the hyphen: a bare prefix lets lane w1 collect w1a-status-cli's PR, which is a confidently-wrong join — worse than the empty one this lane fixes, because it survives review. Caught by the sibling-prefix unit assertion.

gh pr list's default truncation (30, newest first) was measured on this machine at min number 331 — every pr the 21 events carry is older than the window, so an untruncated-list fetch silently un-joins all of them even though the join code is perfect. Caught by the args assertion on the gh call.
Among equal-strength candidates the newest PR must win, or the join depends on gh's return order instead of on data. Flip the tiebreak and the deterministic-old-number case returns the stale PR.

An exact case-folded tail must outrank a descendant of the same lane (l5-template-editor is not l5-template-editor-2). Demote the exact score to a tie and the descendant with the higher number steals the lane.
